## SC01_single_cause_portal_loop  (`single_cause`, hanu_wifi)

> **Probe:** Show every rule that fired for this scenario and confirm they all agree on one cause.

- Reported: ['SYM01', 'SYM06']
- Status: **single_cause**; preferred: {CAUSE01}
- CAUSE01 via R001, R002, R003 (support ['SYM01', 'SYM06'], specificity 2)

Minimal subsets of the reported symptoms giving the same diagnosis: ['SYM01'], ['SYM06'].

Follow-up questions within hanu_wifi (most decisive first):

| ask about | description | status if confirmed | preferred | new rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SYM04 | HANU_Student connects in the corridor but drops signal immediately inside Lab C1 or Lab C2 | multi_fault | {CAUSE01, CAUSE03} | R008 |
| SYM05 | Wi-Fi works on a phone but not on a laptop on the same HANU_Student network | multi_fault | {CAUSE01, CAUSE02} | R006 |
| SYM03 | Wi-Fi connects to HANU_Student, then drops every few minutes inside Nhà C | ambiguous | {CAUSE01, CAUSE02, CAUSE03} | R042, R043 |

Remediation for CAUSE01 (HANU_Student captive portal session has expired or cookie is blocked by the browser): Clear browser cookies and cache, then reconnect to HANU_Student and open a non-HTTPS page to trigger the portal redirect.

## SC07_contradictory_printer  (`contradictory_symptoms`, fit_printer)

> **Probe:** Which pair of symptoms is contradictory? What would a real technician do to resolve this before running inference?

- Reported: ['SYM22', 'SYM25', 'SYM26']
- Status: **contradictory**; preferred: {CAUSE13, CAUSE14}
- CAUSE13 via R034, R039 (support ['SYM22', 'SYM25'], specificity 1)
- CAUSE14 via R036, R041 (support ['SYM22', 'SYM26'], specificity 1)
- Conflict X01: SYM22 vs SYM26 -- Printer reported Offline, yet a job printed successfully from another PC on the same network (the tension named in SC07).
- Conflict X02: SYM22 vs SYM25 -- Same principle as X01: an Offline printer cannot have produced faded or streaky output.

Minimal subsets of the reported symptoms giving the same diagnosis: ['SYM22', 'SYM25'], ['SYM22', 'SYM26'].

Remediation for CAUSE13 (Shared printer driver in P.210 Nhà C is missing or mismatched with the student's OS version): Install the correct driver from the HANU intranet printer page, or ask staff in P.210.
Remediation for CAUSE14 (Printer toner cartridge in P.210 is empty or the printer has an uncleared paper jam sensor): Report to FIT Office; staff will replace toner or physically clear the jam sensor flag.
